author: Gaele_L

title: Choose Spanish Trails - A Cut Above
text: If you're into wine, this is your tour and worth a splurge.  A two-hour drive south of Barcelona lies the Shangri-la of Spanish vineyards - the Priorat.  And if you're lucky enough to get Luca as your guide, your experience will be one of a lifetime.  Three distinctive wineries are featured, a wine-paired three-course lunch, ending with a tasting right in the vineyard itself, surounded by spectacular views of this unique valley.  Spanish Trails is a tour operator worth seeking out for the quality of their offerings and guides.
author: Kay_S

title: Amazing experience in Priorat!
text: Wow! What a wonderful experience. Priorat is one of those places that most people wouldn't think of when visiting Barcelona, but we are both so glad that we booked this tour. From start to finish, Samuel was friendly, funny, and so knowledgeable about the history of the region. We were able to visit three incredible wineries and try some truly outstanding wines, as well as a really top notch lunch. We were also lucky enough to have a very friendly group with us, which made the experience even more unforgettable. We are so grateful to have booked this experience, and would absolutely recommend
author: Briana_S

title: A love letter from Priorat.
text: Samuel created a magical day! It felt like being given a love letter from the Priorat region. Truly incredible scenery, in depth knowledge of the three wineries, and the chosen tastings were exquisite. The curated lunch was outstanding. Met some sweet fellow travelers as well. Book it now!  You won’t be disappointed!  Worth every second to create beautiful memories.
author: Clay_S

title: Great Wine Tour with an Awesome Guide
text: There were 4 of us that booked this tour to Priorat not sure what to expect but the region was amazing- exceeded our expectations.  The tour offered everything…beginning with walking some vineyards, tasting in the vineyards and an amazing lunch at a vineyard and of course more tastings.  The wine is wonderful.  Anthony was our guide and by the end of the day he felt like family!  He was extremely knowledgeable and more than accommodating.   Don’t miss this tour and be sure to request Anthony.
author: Marsha_J

title: Amazing experience, can't recommend enough!
